page.overview:
Who is Jiang?

After many years on the force, Jiang discovered his airbending abilities after Harmonic Convergence, and briefly spent some time studying at Air Temple Island. However, his short fuse and struggled with patience led to his rapid departure, and he continued to work as a detective for the Republic City Police.

Jiang lost everything in the wake of Kuvira's spirit cannon, as he was separated from his family during the evacuation of Republic City. His home was destroyed by the cannon blasts and there were no reports of his husband or children, leading him to presume that they had been taken from him.

After spirit energy canisters went missing from Juniper Kim's laboratory, Jiang took the case into his own hands, with his personal motto being that it was better to ask for forgiveness than permission.

Jiang was always a man of action, but he became more jaded and more willing to break the rules to get results than ever after losing everything. He could easily fly off the handle if provoked or if he saw an opening. While Jiang was still cunning and clever in his middle age, he could let his hot head and recent emotional trauma get the better of him very easily.
